dialog.english:
We did all that running away from
the Numemon, I'm thirsty...
dialog.translation:
Después de huír de los Numemon,
tengo mucha sed...

dialog.english:
But we won't be lucky enough to
find drinks around here.
dialog.translation:
No creo que podamos
encontrar bebida por aquí.

dialog.english:
I never expected to find vending
machines here! There's so many!
dialog.translation:
Nunca hubiese pensado ver tantas
máquinas expendedoras aquí!

dialog.english:
Mimi, you're not thinking of
getting a drink, are you?
dialog.translation:
Mimi, no estarás pensando en
comprar un refresco, no?

dialog.english: Of course I am!

We're not gonna find juice just
like that!
dialog.translation:
No encontrarás zumo así tan
fácilmente!

dialog.english: Really...?

Oh, well, she's still like a
child.

Hmph, this vending machine doesn't
have cola. I wanna drink cola!
dialog.translation:
Esta máquina no tiene Cola.
Quiero beber cola!

dialog.english:
This is great! I want some cola,
too!
dialog.translation:
Es genial!
Quiero cola yo también!

dialog.english: How about we split it 50-50?
I'll give you all of it.
Are you sure?

Yeah, it tastes better when you
don't drink it alone.
dialog.translation:
Si, sabe mejor si no bebes
a solas.

dialog.english: I'll let you have all of it.
You shouldn't give me all of it.

Don't worry! You're the youngest,
after all.
dialog.translation:
No pasa nada! Eres joven, al
fin y al cabo.

dialog.english:
I really don't want to be treated
like that.
dialog.translation:
De veras que no me gusta que me
traten así.

dialog.english: I said you shouldn't worry...
Thanks! Mimi, you're really nice.

Cola, huh...I haven't had that in
a while.
dialog.translation:
Cola, eh... Hace tiempo que no la
pruebo.

dialog.english: How about we split it 50-50?
I only have 100 yen at the moment.

Don't worry about me. It'd be bad
form if I leeched off others.
dialog.translation:
No te preocupes. Estaría feo
aprovecharme de los demás.

dialog.english: I'm not worried about that!

I'm sorry! If I had more than 100
yen on me, I'd buy more than one.
dialog.translation:
Disculpa! Si tuviese más de 100
pesetas, te compraría varias.

dialog.english:
It's all right. You don't need to
spend money on me.
dialog.translation:
Está bien. No necesitas regalarme
dinero.

dialog.english: Is cola really that tasty?

It's very tasty! And it's
refreshing, too!
Wow!
So you like cola, Mimi?
You don't?
I'm more of a tea person.
dialog.translation: A mi me gusta más el té

dialog.english: You're weird, Joe!
Is that how you think of me?

How could anyone like tea more
than cola?
dialog.translation: Como te puede gustar más el té?

dialog.english:
Doesn't look like there are any
vending machines beyond here...
dialog.translation:
No parece que haya más
expendedoras a partir de aquí...

dialog.english:
Mimi, that's enough. Let's keep
going!

Mimi, that's enough. Let's keep
going!

I can't walk, I'm still too
thirsty!
Okay, but hurry up.

I found it! There's a vending
machine! I'm gonna drink some
bubbling, sparkling cola!
dialog.translation:
La encontré! Aquí está la
máquina expendedora. Compraré una
burbujeante cola.

dialog.english: Missy!!
Kyaaaah!!
Wanna go on a date?
Another Numemon?

He's trying to hit on you, Mimi.
What are you gonna do?
dialog.translation:
Te está tirando los trastos,
Mimi. Que vas a hacer?

dialog.english:
Definitely not! Why would I go out
with a thing like that?!
dialog.translation:
Pues ni de broma! Como iba a
salir con semejante bicho?!

dialog.english:
A thing? Why are you calling me a
thing? Now I'm angry! Hey,
everyone, let's attack her!
dialog.translation:
Bicho? Por qué me llamas así?
Ahora me enfado! Eh, todos,
ataquémosle!

dialog.english: W-what's this?!
So many Numemon...
They've surrounded us!
Matt!

Kyaaaaah! They're throwing poop at
us!

If we stay together, we'll just be
easy targets for them!
dialog.translation:
Si estamos juntos seremos un
blanco fácil!

dialog.english:
Okay, we'll split up, run, and
meet up later! Let's go!
dialog.translation:
Vale, separémosnos, corramos
y luego nos vemos. Vamos!

dialog.english: Mimi, get behind me!
Palmon, will you be okay?
Nunu~~
Huh?
That was amazing, Palmon!

That's weird, I didn't even do
anything yet...
dialog.translation:
Que raro, pero si no
hice aún nada...

dialog.english: Kyah!

What's going on? The earth's
shaking...
Missy! Get over here and hide!

Something's coming! We need to
hide!
What? What? What's coming!?
Welcome to Toy Town.

I am Toy Town's mayor. I love the
toys and they love me.
dialog.translation:
Soy el alcalde de Ciudad Juguete.
Amo a los juguetes!

dialog.english:
That's so cool! He must be a good
Digimon!
dialog.translation:
Que guay! Seguro que es un
Digimon bueno!

dialog.english: He should be, but...

It's a trick. He's been acting
weird lately...for some reason.
dialog.translation:
Es un truco, se comporta raro
últimamente... por alguna razón.

dialog.english: Let's play together, everyone.
He left...

He said "let's play together,
everyone", so maybe everyone's in
Toy Town.
dialog.translation:
Dijo "juguemos juntos". Quizás
todos estén en Ciudad Juguete.

dialog.english: Let's go!

Are we going on a date in Toy
Town?
dialog.translation: Vamos a salir en Ciudad Juguete?

dialog.english:
It's not a date! We're going to
look for everyone!
dialog.translation:
No estamos saliendo! Vamos a
buscar a los demás!

dialog.english: Mimi, wait!
Such a blunt girl.
Ah!!
There's Toy Town!

Wow! It looks just like an
amusement park!
dialog.translation:
Guau, parece un parque de
atracciones!

dialog.english:
Mimi...You remember why we came
here, right?
dialog.translation:
Mimi... Recuerdas a qué hemos
venido, no?

dialog.english:
Right...we were trying to meet up
with everyone.

Let's stay on track and look for
them!

Mimi! We won't find anything by
going that way!
dialog.translation:
Mimi! Por ahí no encontraremos
nada!

dialog.english: It's not this way?
Tai! I'm so glad you're okay!
dialog.translation: Tai! Me alegra que estés bien!

dialog.english: This is fun, this is fun!
I don't see anything fun.
I'm super-super-super-happy!

This isn't like you at all,
Matt!

Mimi, something's got to be behind
this.
Sora! I'm so glad to see you here!
dialog.translation:
Sora! Me alegro de que estés
aquí!

dialog.english: This is really, really fun!
What's so fun about it?
Why is Sora acting like this?
dialog.translation: Por qué se comporta así Sora?

dialog.english:
Izzy! I've been looking for
you!
I'm happy, I'm happy!
Izzy...
Joe! Pull yourself together!

This is the best! This is
definitely the best!
dialog.translation: Esto es lo mejor, es lo mejor!

dialog.english: Why's he clapping like a machine?
dialog.translation: Por que aplaude como un mono?

dialog.english: Don't do that...
Yay! Yay!
T.K! What's going on?
Seems like he can't hear you.

It's like everyone's lost their
emotions.
dialog.translation:
Parece que nadie tiene emociones
propias.

dialog.english:
Their Digimon should be with them,
but I haven't seen them at all...
dialog.translation:
Y los Digimon no les acompañan...
no les he visto.

dialog.english: Welcome to Toy Town!
He's back!

Mimi, Monzaemon's a really strong
Digimon! We have to run!
dialog.translation:
Mimi, Monzaemon es muy fuerte!
Tenemos que marcharnos!

dialog.english: But...

Time to erase the children's
emotions and make them into toys
for the toys!
dialog.translation:
Hora de borrar sus emociones, y
convertirles en juguetes para mis
juguetes!

dialog.english: We've been waiting for you, miss.

What's with you!? I don't really
get what happened, but you took
away my friends' emotions, right?
dialog.translation:
Qué tramas!? No sé exactamente
qué pasa, pero has robado las
emociones de mis amigos, no?

dialog.english: Please relax and enjoy yourself.
Mimiiii!
Kyaaah!
We're here to save ya, missy!
Numemon!!
The Numemon... but why?
Let's go! Hi-yah!

Even though they can't do anything
but throw poop...
dialog.translation:
A pesar de sólo poder lanzar
caca...

dialog.english:
Even those dirty and spineless
Numemon are helping her! I have to
protect Mimi, too! I...
dialog.translation:
Hasta esos sucios y blandurrios
Numemon le están ayudando. Tengo
que proteger a Mimi!

dialog.english: Palmon evolved too!

Put 'em up! This is for Mimi and
the Numemon!
dialog.translation:
Alto ahí! Esto es por Mimi y
los Numemon!

dialog.english: Mimi!
Wow! Palmon, that was amazing!

You're hugging me too tightly.
Oww...
Tai!
You're safe and sound, Agumon!

We got captured by Monzaemon, and
he locked us up.
dialog.translation:
Nos capturó Monzaemon y nos
encerró.

dialog.english:
Looks like everyone's back to
normal.
Thank you, Mimi and Palmon!
I'm sorry.

Thoughtlessly throwing away toys
after getting bored of them...
dialog.translation:
Tirando juguetes sin ton ni son
al aburrirme de ellos...

dialog.english: I couldn't allow that.
Ah! A black gear.

So it was because of that gear,
huh?
dialog.translation: Así que esa era la causa, eh?

dialog.english:
Palmon, thank you for bringing my
conceited heart back to its
senses.
dialog.translation:
Palmon, gracias por devolver mi
vanal corazón a sus cabales.

dialog.english:
Missy! Give me a kiss as your
thanks!
dialog.translation:
Preciosa! Un besito para dar
gracias!

dialog.english: No!
Still as blunt as ever, I see...
Hahaha!
